implementation_decisions: GAME_SPEC chapter 5 specifies procedure, not room dimensions. 8.00 x 9.00 x 3.60 m hall plus a 1.70 x 2.12 m rear decon alcove is an authored modest module.
Main portal 2.20 x 2.50 m sliding leaves so a 2.10 x 0.74 m cart and an adult ragdoll can enter without a swing envelope in the arrival lane.
OCRU seated on west lining; operator console and cartridge bank flush to rear wall Y=9.00; recovery along east; cart parking southwest.
Adjacent-section identity is unresolved. Rear utilities are local terminations, not claims on other departments.
Equipment is fictional game art, not medical guidance.
Latest user explicitly asks to retain existing layout as the baseline; no relocation of equipment or decon alcove without measured cause.
Rear alcove remains decontamination. A hose/wand serves the adjacent cart apron so a long cart need not rotate inside the narrow alcove. Handheld use and contamination rules belong to host.
Reserve battery cabinet and rear console remain at inherited placements; no direct Waste discharge is routed through the treatment room.
Fuel Corridor S02_CLEAN is a separate unbound clean header (6.6,21,0),2.0x2.5; Medical entry2.2x2.5. Shared service-junction placement remains connector-owner work; no invented global transform.
